scenario: Contoso Trail Gear (fictional) public product-support intake and triage
important: These tools are SIMULATED for the workshop. Nothing here calls a real system. A model that emits a function-call proposal has NOT executed anything; an application still has to decide whether to run it.

function.name: lookup_order
function.description: Look up a Contoso Trail Gear order by order number. Read-only. Returns synthetic workshop data.

order_number.description: Order number exactly as the customer wrote it.

order_not_found.message: No matching order in the synthetic workshop dataset.

function.name: search_product_knowledge
function.description: Search the public Contoso Trail Gear product knowledge base for care, setup, and troubleshooting articles. Read-only.

query.description: Search phrase derived from the customer's own words.

tent pole replacement.title: Replacing a Summit series tent pole section
tent pole replacement.summary: Pole sections are user replaceable. Order a replacement section and use the repair sleeve in the stuff sack.

tent pole replacement.title: What the Summit tent limited warranty covers
tent pole replacement.summary: Manufacturing defects are covered. Damage from wind above rated load is not.

function.name: create_support_ticket
function.description: Create a support ticket in the (simulated) Contoso Trail Gear support queue. WRITE ACTION. Must be proposed for human approval, never auto-executed in this workshop.

summary.description: Neutral summary using only facts present in the intake message.

policy.no_customer_data: Workshop inputs are synthetic. Do not paste real customer messages, order numbers, or company-confidential content.
policy.write_actions: Any tool with side_effects other than 'none' requires explicit human approval before execution.
policy.unknown_arguments: If a required argument is missing from the intake message, the agent must ask for it instead of inventing a value.
policy.failure_handling: On any failure_mode, the agent reports the failure and recommends a human next step. It does not retry a write action automatically.
